$comment: All durable harness state, owned by the CLI (./AGENTS.sh) — never hand-edit. Keys: setup (present only while guided setup is pending; init drives it), commands (via `cmd set/rm`; verify = definition-of-done step, init = session-start check), features (via `feature ...`; max one in_progress, never delete — mark done), progress (via `log`; append-only, display bounded by the CLI), rules (via `docs add/rm`; curated project knowledge). Future harness versions may add top-level keys. Transient scratch lives in agents.scratch.json (gitignored).

features.title: essentiaNnls timeout
features.notes: O(n^2) recompute: re-extracts full ~79-frame 16384 window every 500ms (~28s/analysis). Fix: incremental per-frame log-spectrum cache + per-analysis wall-clock budget so it never blows time budget.

progress.title: F-00006 essentiaNnls timeout
progress.done: Incremental per-frame log-spectrum cache (keyed by absolute sample offset, computed once, evicted when window slides) replaces O(n^2) full-window re-extraction. Per-analysis wall-clock budget (analysisBudgetMs=1500) caps new-frame work; >=1 frame always progresses, rest fill on later analyses. Refactor preserves NNLS->linear fallback + rotate(9) output.

progress.title: F-00007 meyda power-of-2
progress.done: MeydaDetector.process guards on isPowerOfTwo(pcmChunk.length); skips trailing partial chunks that would make Meyda.extract throw 'Buffer size must be a power of 2'. Returns null, no history mutation. Test added.

progress.title: F-00008 ensemble verify-after-meyda
progress.done: EnsembleDetector.process wraps each child process() in try/catch; a throwing child (e.g. Meyda) no longer aborts the loop so detectors after it (webaudioPcp) still run and vote. Test added.

progress.title: F-00009 webaudioPcp dominant
progress.done: frequencyDataToPcp h=1 self-vote now weighted by selfHarmonicWeight (default 0.3, was implicit 1) so overtone bins (notably a note's strong 3rd partial = the fifth) stop over-crediting the relative dominant; folded sub-harmonics give genuine fundamentals the edge. c_major now settles C major (was G). Streaming regression test (abc-synth) + mechanism test added.

progress.title: F-00010 note-safety core
progress.done: Phase 1 (IMPLEMENTATION.md). New src/theory/note-safety.js: computeNoteSafety(candidates+observedChroma)->{status,safe,careful,avoid,ambiguity,debug}. Internal major/minor+shadow templates (never UI), DEGREE_WEIGHTS, anchor/pentatonic/shadow/chroma bonuses. Score = weighted template support / theoretical-max (rewards candidate agreement) * confidence(top score) + small chroma bonus; thresholds safe>=0.68 careful>=0.32. Ambiguity = chromatic-neighbour 'which version' pairs (both scale tones, mutually exclusive across candidates, close score) -> careful + flagged (C/C# in D/G/Bm). New src/detection/note-safety-aggregator.js: detectionToNoteSafety + getCandidatesFromDetection legacy {tonic,mode,alternate} fallback. Tests: src/theory/note-safety.test.js, 7 scoped cases + note-helper + aggregator. No UI.

rules.text: Audio: mic -> AudioWorklet (4096 PCM) -> Web Worker (src/audio/worker.js) -> KeyDetector. Detectors in src/detection/specifics/, registered in src/detection/factory.js, lazy-loaded.
Detection result contract: { tonic, mode, score, confidence, alternate, chroma }; mode is 'major'|'minor' only.
Profile matching: src/detection/profile-matching.js — Krumhansl-Schmuckler major/minor, Pearson, common-session-key boost. 24 candidates.
Modes = major/minor only. No dorian/mixolydian/etc — that complexity killed bourdon.
Large binaries (WAV, ONNX) never in repo; host on Cloudflare R2 (r2-assets.json + README). No Git LFS.
Never test via vite dev; always npm run build + serve dist/ (npm run preview). playwright.config.js webServer enforces this.
Benchmark ground truth = abc/ filenames; modal tunes map by third: lydian/mixolydian->major, dorian/phrygian->minor.
e2e chromium auto-installed by init cmd 'browsers' (npx playwright install chromium). Fake mic via launch flags in playwright.config.js.

R2 base URL: https://r2-fiddlekey.bysander.net. Agents have NO R2 credentials; never script uploads. New large asset: script to fetch/generate it + name suggestion + r2-assets.json entry, then ask human to upload.
Benchmark: /benchmark page, window.fiddlekeyBenchmark.run({detectors,tunes,durationSec,noise:{type,snrDb,seed}}); deterministic minus wallMs; noise types session/babble/white
Product output = note safety, not key: computeNoteSafety (src/theory/note-safety.js) -> {status,safe,careful,avoid,ambiguity,debug}. UI never reads tonic/mode. (IMPLEMENTATION.md)
detectionToNoteSafety (src/detection/note-safety-aggregator.js): detector output -> computeNoteSafety; falls back to old {tonic,mode} so UI migrates first.
Fingerboard safety colour: safe=green, careful=white, avoid/very-unsure=not drawn. Never a dot for a very-unsure note. (IMPLEMENTATION.md)
